Income-tax assessment for AY 2023-24 enhanced taxable income by ₹574.35 Cr on transfer pricing adjustments and deduction disallowances, set off against available tax losses; demand notice ₹2,26,760.
SEBI challenged the January 16, 2026 SAT order (which set aside SEBI's October 21, 2022 order against the company).
Board decided on May 8, 2026 not to pursue the Rights Issue announced in 2022.

timeline.summary: Bombay Realty launched THREE ICC in Dadar with an estimated revenue potential of ₹6,500 crore.

2026-05-04: Received an income-tax assessment order for AY 2023-24 enhancing taxable income by ₹574.35 Cr, set off against available tax losses, with a demand notice of ₹2,26,760 and separate penalty proceedings initiated.
SEBI challenged the January 16, 2026 SAT order that had set aside SEBI's October 2022 order against Bombay Dyeing.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹395.84 Cr (+10.3% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹21.04 Cr.
